entries.title: Ecclesiastes 12:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
1 The Creator is to be remembered in due time. 8 The preacher's care to edify. 13 The fear of God is the chief antidote of vanity.

Remember. 11:10; Ge 39:2,8,9,23; 1Sa 1:28; 2:18,26; 3:19-21; 16:7,12,13, 1Sa 17:36,37; 1Ki 3:6-12; 14:13; 18:12; 2Ch 34:2,3; Ps 22:9,10 Ps 34:11; 71:17,18; Pr 8:17; 22:6; Isa 26:8; La 3:27; Da 1:8,9,17 Lu 1:15; 2:40-52; 18:16; Eph 6:4; 2Ti 3:15 while. 11:8; Job 30:2; Ps 90:10; Ho 7:9 when. 2Sa 19:35

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 12:9
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: moreover, because the Preacher was wise. or, the more wisethe Preacher was, etc. he still. 1Ki 8:12-21; 10:8 he gave. 1Ki 4:32; Pr 1:1; 10:1; 25:1

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 12:10
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Preacher. 1:1,12 acceptable words. Heb. words of delight. Pr 15:23,26; 16:21-24; 25:11,12; 1Ti 1:15 written. Pr 1:1-6; 8:6-10; 22:17-21; Lu 1:1-4; Joh 3:11; Col 1:5

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 12:11
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: as goads. Jer 23:29; Mt 3:7; Ac 2:37; 2Co 10:4; Heb 4:12 masters. Joh 3:10 given. Ge 49:24; Ps 23:1; 80:1; Isa 40:11; Eze 34:23; Joh 10:14; Heb 13:20 1Pe 5:4

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 12:12
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: by these. Lu 16:29-31; Joh 5:39; 20:31; 21:25; 2Pe 1:19-21 study. or, reading. weariness. 1:18

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 12:13
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter. or, The endof the matter, even all that hath been heard is. Fear. 5:7; 8:12; Ge 22:12; De 6:2; 10:12; Ps 111:10; 112:1; 145:19; 147:11 Pr 1:7; 23:17; 1Pe 2:17; Re 19:5 for. 2:3; 6:12; Job 28:28; Ps 115:13-15; Pr 19:23; Lu 1:50
